summary_en: 1,000,000 shares (2.79% of shares outstanding) ¥800M upper limit. Open-market purchase on TSE. Acquisition period: 17 June 2026 – 16 June 2027. Rationale: enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency; enable flexible capital policy response to future operational changes.
title_en: Notice of Board Resolution on Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 15 June 2026, EUCALIA Inc.'s board of directors authorized a share buyback programme under the Companies Act Section 459(1) and the company's articles of association. The programme permits the acquisition of up to 1,000,000 ordinary shares (representing 2.79% of the 35,809,300 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for an aggregate maximum of ¥800 million over the period 17 June 2026 through 16 June 2027. Purchases will be executed via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a discretionary trading agreement. The board stated the rationale as enhancing shareholder returns, improving capital efficiency, and enabling flexible capital policy decisions in response to future business environment changes.
